findings.evidenceJa: 黒衣を朱色に染め
findings.governingReading: Kirei’s black clerical clothing is stained vermilion with blood.
findings.explanation: The English narrows his clothing to a cloak and replaces the color image with a generic blood description.

findings.evidenceJa: アサシンの姿はとうにない
findings.governingReading: By the time Kirei turns, Assassin has already been gone for some time.
findings.explanation: The English omits the temporal emphasis establishing that Assassin escaped the pinning earlier.

findings.highlight: a spirit that used worms to tamper with this world
findings.evidenceJa: 蟲を触媒にしてこちらに干渉する霊体
findings.governingReading: Zouken is a spiritual body that uses worms as catalysts to interfere with this side or plane.
findings.explanation: The English changes mediated manifestation into vaguely tampering with the world.

findings.highlight: The magus had a strong binding to the world
findings.evidenceJa: 人間にしては強い括りで留まっていた魔術師殿
findings.governingReading: For a human, the magus had remained within a notably strong category of being.
findings.explanation: The English invents a binding to the world and loses the human-relative strength classification.

findings.highlight: the holy words of the Bible
findings.evidenceJa: 経典による聖言
findings.governingReading: The holy words derive from the Church’s scripture or sacred text.
findings.explanation: The English specifies the Bible where the fictional terminology remains broader.

findings.highlight: I am not so foolish as that.
findings.evidenceJa: それほど酔狂ではない
findings.governingReading: Assassin says he is not so eccentric, quixotic, or perversely whimsical as to avenge Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English turns cultivated detachment into a judgment of stupidity.

findings.evidenceJa: 地獄の天使
findings.governingReading: The arm bears the name of an angel of Hell.
findings.explanation: The English changes origin or domain into the theological category “fallen angel.”

findings.highlight: A cursed arm that creates an image of the target’s heart and swaps it with the real heart.
findings.evidenceJa: 対象の心臓とまったく同じ偶像を作り、反鏡存在とする事で実像の心臓とすり替える呪いの腕
findings.governingReading: The arm creates an idol exactly identical to the target’s heart, establishes it as a counter-mirror existence, and substitutes it for the real heart.
findings.explanation: The English omits exact identity and the counter-mirror mechanism that enables substitution.

findings.evidenceJa: 憎々しげに舌打ちをするアサシン
findings.governingReading: Assassin clicks his tongue resentfully or hatefully.
findings.explanation: The English reverses outward resentment into self-deprecation and domesticates the sharp click as “tut-tuts.”

findings.evidenceJa: 放たれていた殺気が途絶える
findings.governingReading: The killing intent Assassin had been emitting abruptly ceases.
findings.explanation: The English again weakens active murderous intent into hostility.

findings.highlight: He must be satisfied with the answer
findings.evidenceJa: 神父の答えに満足したのか
findings.governingReading: Perhaps satisfied by Kirei’s answer, Assassin readily withdraws.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the narrator’s tentative explanation into near-certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 臓硯の乗り物
findings.governingReading: Zouken intends Sakura’s emptied Grail body as a vehicle or vessel he can occupy.
findings.explanation: The English broadens bodily possession into using her as a tool.

findings.evidenceJa: “寄り代”で在り続けて
findings.governingReading: Sakura must remain a yorishiro: a vessel or physical receptacle for the curse.
findings.explanation: The English changes the ritual receptacle into the contractual role Master.

findings.highlight: You will never find it." indent=true indentOffset=1]
findings.evidenceJa: おまえには永遠にない
findings.governingReading: Zouken’s recalled taunt says that ordinary happiness will never exist for Kirei.
findings.explanation: A malformed layout command leaks visibly into the English sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 一時だけ、眠るように目蓋を閉じた
findings.governingReading: Kirei closes his eyelids as though sleeping, but only for a moment.
findings.explanation: The English omits both the sleep comparison and brief duration.

findings.evidenceJa: 十年以上も前
findings.governingReading: The recollection is from more than ten years earlier.
findings.explanation: The English makes the open lower bound exactly ten years.

findings.evidenceJa: 男の青年期
findings.governingReading: The man’s youth or young adulthood was devoted solely to overcoming his lack.
findings.explanation: The English narrows 青年期 to adolescence.

findings.evidenceJa: 男の苦行、苦悩
findings.governingReading: His ascetic ordeals and anguish remained unhealed.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the theological place or state “purgatory” and loses deliberate mortification or ordeal.

findings.highlight: one can only dream about it
findings.evidenceJa: それを夢見ない人間はいない
findings.governingReading: There is no person who does not dream of that peaceful domestic life, even if they hate it.
findings.explanation: The English changes inevitability of the dream into its remaining merely a dream or impossibility.

findings.evidenceJa: 男の絶望は近かった
findings.governingReading: The man’s despair was drawing near as even this saint failed to heal him.
findings.explanation: The English changes an approaching culmination into an already established state.

findings.evidenceJa: ならばもはや
findings.governingReading: Then there was no longer any need to live and question right and wrong.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “Then” and “there.”

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも速やかだった
findings.governingReading: The end came far too swiftly or with overwhelming promptness.
findings.explanation: The English weakens extreme speed into a relative comparison.

findings.highlight: looked up at the man and smiled
findings.evidenceJa: 掠れていく意識で男を見上げて
findings.governingReading: With consciousness fading away, the blood-covered woman looks up and smiles.
findings.explanation: The English omits her failing consciousness.

findings.highlight: He can’t remember her voice or her face.
findings.evidenceJa: あの女の声はおろか、顔さえも思い出せない
findings.governingReading: Kirei cannot recall even her voice, much less her face.
findings.explanation: The English preserves both losses but removes their emphatic scale.

findings.evidenceJa: 答えを出す事を、永遠に止めた
findings.governingReading: He permanently stops himself from reaching an answer.
findings.explanation: The English omits permanence and changes refusal to conclude into a search that merely ended.

findings.highlight: The memory of the man who feeds on others’ misfortunes.
findings.evidenceJa: 世界が穢れるほど満たされる男
findings.governingReading: The remembered man becomes more fulfilled as the world grows more corrupted.
findings.explanation: The English retains feeding on others’ misery but omits the world-scale relation between corruption and fulfillment.

findings.evidenceJa: その道を阻まれた
findings.governingReading: A girl physically blocks Kirei’s path.
findings.explanation: The English changes spatial obstruction into interruption of his action.

findings.highlight: The amount and the presence of her magical energy is beyond human capabilities.
findings.evidenceJa: 魔力量、存在感、ともに人間のモノではない
findings.governingReading: Both Sakura’s quantity of magical energy and her existential presence are nonhuman.
findings.explanation: The English collapses two different subjects into “the amount and the presence of her magical energy” and mismatches them with singular “is.”

findings.highlight: unless your mind is attuned to the curse
findings.evidenceJa: 体だけではない。精神まであの“呪い”に同調しなければ
findings.governingReading: Transformation of this degree requires not only bodily corruption but mental attunement to the curse as well.
findings.explanation: The English omits the body/mind double condition.

findings.highlight: Nee-san, who lived without any troubles
findings.evidenceJa: わたしとは何もかも違う
findings.governingReading: Sakura condemns the sister who differs from her in every respect and has lived without hardship.
findings.explanation: The English omits the total contrast between them.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしを思い知らせてあげたら
findings.governingReading: Sakura imagines forcing everyone who failed to help her to learn what she is and feel the consequence.
findings.explanation: The English reduces retaliatory demonstration to making people notice that she exists.

findings.evidenceJa: 昏い悦び
findings.governingReading: Sakura smiles as though immersed in dark pleasure.
findings.explanation: The English reverses moral coloration by translating “dark” as “sacred.”

findings.highlight: one of the qualities to adapt
findings.evidenceJa: 適合する為の素質
findings.governingReading: Her darkness was an aptitude that enabled her compatibility or adaptation.
findings.explanation: The English produces the unnatural phrase “qualities to adapt” and weakens technical aptitude.

findings.highlight: That’s the only logical reason for her change.
findings.evidenceJa: そうとしか思えない豹変ぶりだった
findings.governingReading: Her bewitching transformation is so extreme that a separate personality seems the only explanation—an appearance Kirei immediately rejects.
findings.explanation: The English calls it the only logical reason, strengthening a provisional impression before the rebuttal.

findings.evidenceJa: えなにを、ですか
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s startled “Eh?” precedes her question.
findings.explanation: The English fuses the interjection and question.

findings.evidenceJa: それは真実だったのか
findings.governingReading: The narration asks whether Kirei’s accusation is true.
findings.explanation: The English turns an open question into absolute authorial confirmation.

findings.evidenceJa: ぎり、と歯を噛み
findings.governingReading: Sakura bites down with an audible grinding sound.
findings.explanation: The English omits the sound.

findings.evidenceJa: 侵食は烈火の如く
findings.governingReading: The shadow’s encroachment or corrosion spreads like a raging fire.
findings.explanation: The English uses the legalistic false friend “infringement,” obscuring physical magical invasion.

findings.highlight: The shadow covers the ground in an instant.
findings.evidenceJa: 今までの比ではない
findings.governingReading: The shadow’s speed is beyond comparison with anything it displayed before.
findings.explanation: The English preserves instantaneous spread but omits the explicit escalation from prior behavior.

findings.highlight: a position where I can make anyone realize whatever I want
findings.evidenceJa: 一方的に思い知らせる立場
findings.governingReading: Sakura now claims the position of unilaterally making others experience or understand what they did to her.
findings.explanation: The English turns directed retribution into arbitrary power to make anyone realize anything.

findings.evidenceJa: 少女の口はしに浮かぶ
findings.governingReading: A cruel smile rises specifically at the corner of Sakura’s mouth.
findings.explanation: The English omits the restrained facial staging.

findings.evidenceJa: 一息で急速に間合いを離す
findings.governingReading: Kirei opens the combat interval rapidly in a single breath.
findings.explanation: The English omits the one-breath timing and technical spacing.

findings.evidenceJa: わずか一足で離脱した
findings.governingReading: Kirei disengages in only one step.
findings.explanation: The English changes a step into a jump.

findings.evidenceJa: くすり、という笑い声
findings.governingReading: Sakura gives a small, audible giggle.
findings.explanation: The English changes sound into a visual expression.

findings.evidenceJa: 力なく大地に転げ落ちた
findings.governingReading: Kirei tumbles helplessly down to the earth.
findings.explanation: The English omits both powerlessness and rolling motion.

findings.evidenceJa: 口から紅い塊を吐き出しながら
findings.governingReading: Kirei collapses while vomiting a red clot or mass from his mouth.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the concrete red mass into blood.

findings.highlight: Every time he tries to breathe, it wells up in his throat.
findings.evidenceJa: 肺を動かすたび、際限なく喉から吐き出されていく
findings.governingReading: Every attempt to move his lungs for breath expels blood endlessly from his throat.
findings.explanation: The English changes outward expulsion into blood merely welling up and weakens the unbounded flow.

findings.evidenceJa: ふそうか。では、今のは
findings.governingReading: Kirei exhales or laughs faintly, then says he understands.
findings.explanation: The English fuses “Ha” and “I.”

findings.highlight: I can squash your organs too if you want.
findings.evidenceJa: お望みなら中身を全部潰してあげましょうか
findings.governingReading: Sakura offers once to crush all of Kirei’s insides.
findings.explanation: The English prints two overlapping versions of the same threat.

findings.highlight: a speck next to her total magical energy
findings.evidenceJa: 部屋の片隅につもった塵ほどの魔力
findings.governingReading: Even magical energy no greater than dust accumulated in a room’s corner still belongs to Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes an absolute miniature image into a quantity small only relative to her total power.

findings.evidenceJa: 少女の可憐な指
findings.governingReading: Sakura’s delicate, lovely fingers close as though twisting an invisible doll apart.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes physical slenderness for the dissonant daintiness of the murder gesture.

findings.evidenceJa: ごきん、という音
findings.governingReading: A hard bone-cracking “gokin” sounds.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the distinct crack into crushing.

findings.evidenceJa: 一秒もかからずに
findings.governingReading: Kirei will be completely dead in less than one second.
findings.explanation: The English changes a strict under-one-second interval into sometime within the next second.

findings.evidenceJa: 猛烈な吐き気と不快感
findings.governingReading: Sakura is overcome by violent nausea and revulsion or discomfort.
findings.explanation: The English adds an entire sentence in which she coughs blood, unsupported by the Japanese.

findings.evidenceJa: 少女の体を覆った黒衣
findings.governingReading: The black garment covering Sakura’s body swells one size larger.
findings.explanation: The English turns her manifested black clothing into a shadow on her body.

findings.evidenceJa: 血塗れの神父服
findings.governingReading: Only Kirei’s blood-soaked priestly clothes remain.
findings.explanation: The English genericizes the clerical clothing as an outfit.
